info.description:
FD Lifecycle Demo (academic-v1).

Runnable REST narrative for the college-lab fixed-deposit milestone: authenticate -> view eligible products -> book -> fund -> ACTIVE -> calculate/accrue interest -> MATURED -> close -> inspect transaction history, plus a premature-closure variant.

IMPORTANT - academic internal records: funding, closure, settlement, and penalty responses are internal academic recordkeeping entries. No external payment rail is called and no real money moves.

How to authenticate: POST http://localhost:8080/api/v1/auth/login with your lab credentials, copy the JWT from the response, and paste it into the collection variable `authToken` (replace YOUR_JWT_HERE). Every request sends `Authorization: Bearer {{authToken}}`.

Run order: execute Folder 1, then Folder 2, then Folder 3 (normal closure), then Folder 4 (premature variant on a second FD). `accountId`, `accountId2`, and `closureId` are chained automatically from responses where the script can read them; otherwise copy the ids from the response body into the collection variables manually.
info.name: FD Lifecycle Demo (academic-v1)

item.description: List eligible products, book an FD, and fund it with the exact principal.

request.description: Expected: 200 with a list of eligible product offers (product id/code, contracted annual rate as a decimal fraction, tenure range, currency). Copy a `product_id` into the Book request body.

Expected: 201 with the booked account (account id, status PENDING, principal, tenure, internal-record wording). Replace `product_id` with an id from List products. The test script stores the account id into `accountId`.

Expected: 200 with funding confirmation (FUNDING/DEPOSIT internal record, status ACTIVE). Amount must equal the booked principal exactly; the currency must match the booking. Truthful internal record: no external payment settlement is performed.

item.name: 1 Products & Booking

item.description: Check status, accrue interest, and mature the funded FD.

request.description: Expected: 200 with the account snapshot (status such as ACTIVE, principal, contracted rate, funding_recorded=true once funded).

Expected: 200 with the accrual result (accrued interest computed with BigDecimal Actual/365 HALF_UP, running balance). Omit `business_date` to use the server business date; a malformed date returns 400, never 500.
Expected: 200 with the time-ordered accrual rows for the account.
Expected: 200 with cumulative accrued interest plus running balance.
Expected: 200 with the maturity result (status MATURED, maturity amount = principal + interest). Only a funded/active FD past its term can mature.

item.name: 2 Status & Interest

item.description: Close the matured FD normally and read the unified history timeline.

request.description: Expected: 200 with ClosureResponse (status CLOSED, settlement_amount = principal + interest, internal-record wording). Only a MATURED account can be closed normally.

Expected: 200 with the unified time-ordered timeline merging funding, accrual, maturity, closure, and settlement entries (type, amount, date, running balance where known). Optional filters: ?from_date=yyyy-MM-dd&to_date=yyyy-MM-dd&txn_type_id=<id>.

DOCUMENTED ERROR EXAMPLE. Run this against a funded-but-not-matured FD (e.g. a fresh account before Folder 2 step Mature). Expected: 409 with an invalid-transition message; the account stays open and no closure record is written. This uses the same implemented close endpoint, so it stays green in the consistency check.

item.name: 3 Normal Closure

item.description: Book a second FD, close it early with penalty math, and see the unsupported-rule 422 error.

request.description: Expected: 201 with the second booked account. Use a product that HAS a CLOSURE_PENALTY rule for the penalty path. The test script stores the account id into `accountId2`.
Expected: 200 with funding confirmation (status ACTIVE) for the second FD.

Expected: 201 with a PENDING premature-closure request showing the penalized quote: penalized rate = contracted annual rate minus the product CLOSURE_PENALTY points, floored at zero; premature interest over elapsed days; settlement = principal + penalized interest. The test script stores the closure id into `closureId`.
Expected: 200 with the time-ordered premature-closure requests (PENDING then APPROVED) including server-recomputed penalized rates.

Expected: 200 with the APPROVED closure (status PREMATURELY_CLOSED, settlement_amount = principal + penalized interest). History gains PENALTY and CLOSURE records. Self-service: the same owning customer approves.
Expected: 200 with the timeline showing FUNDING, PENALTY, and CLOSURE entries for the prematurely closed FD.

item.name: DOC 422 - premature on product without CLOSURE_PENALTY

request.description: DOCUMENTED ERROR EXAMPLE. Book and fund an FD on a product with NO CLOSURE_PENALTY rule, then run this request against it. Expected: 422 with an unsupported-business-rule message; the FD stays open and no records are written. This uses the same implemented premature-closure endpoint, so it stays green in the consistency check.

item.name: 4 Premature Variant
